columns.name: CONSOLIDATED_CHANGE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each consolidated change event record.

columns.name: CHANGE_EVENT_SET_ID
columns.description: References the change event set this consolidated event change belongs.

columns.name: CHANGE_EVENT_IDS
columns.description:
A comma-separated list of the ids of the change events that are consolidated
into this record.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the object affected by the consolidated change event.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the object affected by the consolidated change event.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the assignment related to the consolidated change event.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person related to the consolidated change event.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the schedule unit impacted by the consolidated change event.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: PUBLISH_INSTANT
columns.description: Timestamp when the consolidated change event was published.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CHANGES_CONSOLIDATED
columns.description: Consolidated attribute changes related to the consolidated change event.

columns.name: DELETE_EVENT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the consolidated change event denotes a deletion.

columns.name: NOTIFIABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if the consolidated event needs to be considered as origin of notified impacts.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE_ID
